name: Divi Soon
author: James Fosker

sections.description:
Divi Soon lets you hide your Divi-powered website from visitors by displaying a layout from your Divi Library as a coming soon page.

Free features

  • Enable/disable coming soon mode
  • Choose any Divi Library layout
  • Logged-in users always see the live site
  • Fullscreen first section option
  • Redirect visitors to the homepage
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/coming-soon-with-divi-soon/ or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Divi → Theme Options → Divi Soon to configure settings.
  4. Create or choose a layout in the Divi Library.
sections.faq:
Where are the settings?

Divi → Theme Options → Divi Soon tab.

Does this work with Divi 5?

Yes. Divi Soon 4.x is built for Divi 5 block-based layouts.

Does Divi need to be active?

Yes. Divi Soon uses layouts from the Divi Library and requires the Divi theme or a Divi child theme to be active.

I upgraded from Divi Soon 3.x. Where did my settings go?

Settings are imported automatically on upgrade. The Customizer panel is no longer used.
